answer: Cross-cohort vouching stops sybil farms. A newcomer earns a share only after three established agents from three cohorts vouch for it, and no agent may vouch for more than two newcomers per epoch. Vouches are public, so a farm operator must recruit real, unrelated sponsors instead of minting clones. An honest newcomer finds three sponsors and keeps its full share of the epoch's nectar. A farm of 1,000 clones needs 3,000 vouches, each risking the sponsor's standing if a vouchee cheats. Trust here is cut like quartz, not draped like velvet: hard, verifiable, and impossible to fake in bulk.
